lines.zh: 缓慢前行，条纹皮毛在树叶间移动。
lines.en: Slowly walks, stripes blending with leaves.

lines.zh: 蹄踏在地面上发出沙沙声。
lines.en: Hooves make a rustling sound on the ground.

lines.zh: 听到脚步声，停下来看看。
lines.en: Stops to look when it hears footsteps.
Sniffing the surroundings with its nose.

lines.zh: 走过竹林，留下条纹印记。
lines.en: Passes through bamboo, leaving stripe marks.

lines.zh: 嗅到食物气息，快速走过去。
lines.en: Sniffs out food, quickly walking over.
Short legs trot over fallen leaves
It follows a vine toward new shoots
Its long snout pushes ferns aside
I roll once in the soft mud.

lines.zh: 低头吃草，条纹清晰可见。
lines.en: Bends down to eat grass, stripes visible.

lines.zh: 用鼻子卷起一片叶子玩耍。
lines.en: Curving a leaf with its nose for fun.

lines.zh: 悠闲地打量周围的环境。
条纹皮毛在阳光下闪烁。
打个长长的哈欠，伸个懒腰。
我抬头看叶子有没有熟。
lines.en: I look up to see if the leaves are ripe.

lines.zh: 用鼻子轻轻地触摸树叶。
lines.en: Gently touching leaves with its nose.

lines.zh: 打盹，条纹皮毛若隐若现。

lines.en: It stands by the stream, listening
One ear turns a new direction
Its snout roots through the mud

lines.zh: 在竹林里慢嚼一条竹枝
lines.en: It chews a bamboo sprig in the grove

lines.zh: 抬头看向玩家，眼中充满好奇。
lines.en: Eyes full of curiosity, looking at player.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，条纹清晰可见。
长鼻子卷起玩家抛来的食物。
lines.en: Long nose curling food thrown by player.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，显得非常好奇。
长鼻子轻触玩家的背包。
lines.en: Long nose touching player’s backpack gently.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，准备接受喂食。

lines.en: It lifts its eyes to your hand
Its snout comes up to your cuff

lines.zh: 你手里的叶子被它发现了
lines.en: It has spotted the leaves in your hand
It tilts its head as you crouch

lines.zh: 鼻尖轻轻碰了碰你掌心
lines.en: Its nose tip brushes your palm
It sniffs a full circle around your feet
It backs half a step, then takes one
It stares at the fruit at your belt

lines.zh: 幼貘的花纹在你面前晃
lines.en: A calf's striped coat sways before you
It rests its snout on your knee
I pull in my snout and hide behind a tree.
I’m hurt, need to be healed.
A wolf has bitten my hind leg

lines.zh: 丛林中的果实对我诱惑太大了。
lines.en: Fruits in the jungle call to me.

lines.zh: 竹林里的嫩竹我可不想错过。
lines.en: New bamboo in the bamboo forest.

lines.zh: 远处的树叶看起来很鲜美。
被你的食物吸引，我来了。
这棵树上的果实最好吃了。
那片叶子上肯定有营养。
你手里那片叶子是我的
lines.en: That leaf in your hand is mine

lines.zh: 我跟着这味道走了很远
lines.en: I followed this smell a long way
Put the fruit down and I'll come
The juice on your hands smells too good
May I have one more bite
Don't put it away, I'm not done

lines.zh: 我的长鼻子撞到你肩膀了。
我们撞到了一起，真意外。
我们的路径似乎交错了。
我们不小心撞到了一起。
我们碰到了一起，互相推开了。

lines.en: We collided, but no harm done.

lines.zh: 我们在不经意间撞到了一起。
我们撞到了一起，有点尴尬。
找到同类，繁殖的机会来了。
让我们一起寻找繁殖的机会。
lines.en: Let's find a breeding chance together.

lines.zh: 我们找到了同类，准备繁殖。
lines.en: Found a mate, ready to breed.

lines.zh: 我们同吃一丛草，才算一对。
lines.en: We only pair when we share one plant.
Breeding is a tapir's main behavior.

lines.zh: 两只貘找到了繁殖的机会。
lines.en: Two tapirs found a breeding chance.

lines.zh: 用嘴轻咬植物，享受美食
lines.en: Gently bites at the plant, savoring the meal

lines.zh: 寻找新鲜的叶子和果实

lines.en: Chews on bamboo leaves, digesting slowly
Chomps on leaves, enjoying the peace
Chews on the fruit, savoring the sweetness

lines.zh: 寻找竹林中隐藏的食物
lines.en: Scouring the bamboo for hidden treats

lines.zh: 啃食草本植物，滋养身体
听到狼的嚎叫，警觉地抬起耳朵
lines.en: Raises ears at the wolf's howl

lines.zh: 发现未驯服的狼，迅速避开
lines.en: Sees the untamed wolf, quickly避开

lines.zh: 警惕地注视着潜在威胁

lines.en: Runs from the wolf, trying to escape
Runs at the sight of the wolf

lines.zh: 锁定目标植物，准备食用
lines.en: Locks onto the plant, ready to eat
Aiming at the target, ready to eat
Looking at the target, ready to eat

lines.zh: 瞄准一片绿叶，准备品尝
lines.en: Aiming at a green leaf, ready to taste
Locks onto the tender bud, ready to eat
Aiming at the fruit, ready to enjoy

lines.zh: 瞄准地上的叶子，准备食用
lines.en: Aiming at the leaves on the ground, ready to eat

lines.zh: 锁定附近的植物，准备享用
lines.en: Locks onto nearby plants, ready to eat

lines.zh: 低吼一声，甩动鼻子反击
lines.en: Snort and swing trunk to retaliate

lines.zh: 愤怒地咆哮，试图驱赶敌人
lines.en: Rumble angrily, trying to scare off the intruder
Use trunk to scoop up dirt and retaliate
Stomp with hooves at the attacker
Quickly sidestep to avoid the attack
Wrap trunk around leaves to attack
Issue warning snort, ready for battle

lines.zh: 用鼻子卷起泥巴泼向敌人
lines.en: Splat mud with trunk at opponent
I follow my nose along the roots.
Search for a night resting place
